system.description:
Starting Move. When you beseech your deity to perform a miracle, choose a Miracle you know and roll+WIS.

You start with 2 Miracles known. When you Level Up, you can choose to Learn a New Miracle instead of another benefit.

success.label: Success!
success.value: You successfully Invoke the Miracle and its effects come to pass.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value:
The Miracle is still successful but choose one consequence:
• The Miracle's Risk manifests as well.
• The strain of channeling divine energy costs you 1 Spirit.
• Your deity demands something of you, the GM will say what.
